symbols.name: valid_index
symbols.docstring:
Check whether index lies inside a zero-based sequence of the given length.

>>> valid_index(0, 3)
True
>>> valid_index(2, 3)
True
>>> valid_index(3, 3)
False
>>> valid_index(-1, 3)
False
